summary: One-frame copy of the steering request (esv::steering::Request, 0x30 bytes) that esv::steering::StateSystem started this frame for an entity (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x9BC9C0 StateSystem::ProcessBeginRequests copies the whole request into it after WasAborted(request Guid) is false). Requests come from lock/trap/placement SteeringRequestOneFrameComponents. Seen.py context: born at the first shove/throw step (thrown items turn to a direction) and in dialogues where characters turn.

fields.name: Data
fields.evidence: Storage of ls::Variant<eoc::steering::ToDirection, eoc::steering::ToEntity> (Toolkit name text in EoCServer.dll+0x9BC060): ToDirection writes a normalized vec3 (x, y, z floats; ProcessBeginRequests normalizes position deltas into +0/+8); ToEntity holds an EntityHandle in +0 (checked for validity after FUN_1809bc060 when index == 1). Live: floats such as 0xBF7FFFFF (-1.0) and handles.

fields.name: Type
fields.evidence: Variant index at +0xC (FUN_1809bc060 switches on it: 0 = ToDirection, 1 = ToEntity). Live: 0/1.

fields.name: Flags
fields.evidence: Request +0x10 (4 bytes) copied; ProcessSteering tests bits 1, 2, 4, 8 of the same value in StateComponent (+0x10). Live: 0 or 0xF.

fields.name: RequestId
fields.evidence: Request +0x18 Guid (ls::Guid::Guid constructs it when a request is built; WasAborted(.., Guid* request+0x18)); copied to LifetimeComponent +0 by ProcessLifetime. Live: random 16 bytes.

fields.name: Lifetime
fields.evidence: Request +0x28 float, default 0x4B18967F (9999999.0) then set to 1.0 in the built request; ProcessLifetime copies it into LifetimeComponent +0x10, which counts down. Live: 1, 1.5, 2.31, 9999999.
